records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Comparable sales increased 8.7% for the quarter, with strong performance from our stores, which were up 10.1% for the third quarter, with all regions reporting sales growth over last year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Stores that have been open for at least 13 months are included in comparable sales.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As a result, our inventory level at the end of the third quarter was intentionally up 29.8% from last year, but was down 11.1%, when compared to the end of the third quarter in fiscal 2019 inventory, or pre-pandemic levels.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in dollars per transactions was attributable to our reduced reliance on promotions and a shift in merchandise mix to higher-price items, such as tailored clothing.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: At October 29, 2022, we continued to provide a valuation allowance of $2.4 million, primarily against certain state and foreign net operating losses ("NOLs").
